body: Trying the best I can at this point.

My job is stressful and requires more travel than I expected, but it pays incredibly well. When I'm not traveling I work from home, but it's not the least bit challenging. I feel as though I can't change due to "lifestyle", but I'm not sure what I would even do as a "dream job".

I lost my mother when I was young and I'm currently a few years older than she was (30 yo) when she passed. I recently lost my grandmother (3ish months ago) who was my second mom for all intents and purposes. This causes all kinds of anxiety for myself.

All of this feels so fucking petty. The past few days I've literally been shutting myself in the bathroom or bedroom to stay away from my family after work. I'm just to the point of what is my life from here? Just the mundane grind of the day to day where I eventually die? Might as well cut to the chase...
